correctness.rationale: An exact, closed invariant receptive-edge class follows from upper/lower intermediate–extreme gaps bounded by Δ/n<c0. On that class extreme opinion gap decays geometrically at factor 1/(n−1), missing-edge confidence at factor δ. Strict inequality yields precise threshold and integer repair time including equality boundary; self-inclusive reversible averaging yields exact stationary weighted consensus otherwise. Embedded exact-rational code replay passes 69 finite examples; the proof works for every integer n≥3.

value.rationale: A natural, nonempty open parameter family isolates the feedback competition between trust erosion and opinion relaxation, furnishing a sharp n-dependent bifurcation between exact finite-time consensus and forever incomplete effective-graph consensus, as well as a diverging restoration time. It gives quantitative mechanism for the unreceptive-consensus effect highlighted in the originating paper, beyond a routine negative check or fixed small example.
